Subject: MAP checkpoint: Security package commitments & delivery schedule

Hi Olivia / Dan —

Thanks again for taking time this morning. Quick recap + the MAP attachments we discussed. Goal here is a short, actionable set of milestones so your Security + Procurement teams have clear owners and due dates for the SOC 2 questionnaire and evidence delivery.

Attached: Keystone_SOC2_Questionnaire_v2.pdf (our annotated questionnaire), evidence_inventory_template.xlsx, map-draft-security-milestones-20270628.xlsx (draft).

Proposed milestones (high level):
- Q1: Questionnaire completion (Keystone) — due 2027-07-06 — owner: Olivia Barnes
- Q2: Evidence intake (spread across teams) — due 2027-07-20 — owner: Keystone evidence coordinator (TBD)
- Q3: Redwood security review & clarifications — due 2027-07-27 — owner: Monica Patel (Redwood)
- Q4: Final package delivery (Keystone) — target close 2027-08-04 — owner: Dan Lee

Dependencies: access to sample logs (SIEM export), confirmation of retention policy docs, and a point of contact for evidence uploads (SFTP or shared Drive). Please flag anything missing or dates that look aggressive.

Next steps I propose:
1) Olivia — confirm owners for evidence collection and whether SFTP or Drive is preferred for upload (reply by EOD Thu 6/30).
2) Redwood (Marissa / Ben / Monica) — we’ll lock internal owners and confirm internal review SLOs by Friday 7/1.
3) Schedule a 30-min follow-up next week to walk the questionnaire and handoff (I’ll send a calendar invite).

Thanks — looking forward to getting this across the line quickly.

—
Dylan Brooks
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Dylan —

Thanks for the clear recap and the draft MAP. Quick replies from my side:
- Questionnaire: I can own that and will coordinate with our internal controls lead, Sara H., for technical answers. We aim to get the questionnaire back by 7/06 as you requested.
- Evidence uploads: Our security team prefers SFTP for larger logs and Drive for config docs. Dan — can you confirm we can provision an SFTP drop for Redwood access?
- Owners: I’ll confirm the evidence coordinator by EOD Wednesday 6/30.

Two clarifying asks:
1) The annotated questionnaire references a few items (A.3, B.1) where you’ve marked ‘sample logs required’. Can Monica clarify what exact sample exports we need (SIEM vendor / timeframe / format)?
2) Do you have a preference for Redwoods’ internal reviewer turnaround — 3 business days per submission acceptable?

I’ll attach our internal intake template once Sara reviews (will be a small Excel).

Thanks — Olivia

- Marissa: I'll need your help coordinating procurement timing with Olivia (they may need a PO or vendor form). Also confirm whether we should push the questionnaire due date to 7/08 if their intake owner is delayed — I'll flag both options in the MAP.

I’m drafting an updated MAP worksheet (attached) that will show two timelines (optimistic + contingency). Plan to send updated file to Olivia and Dan by tomorrow EOD with a 30-min follow-up invite for Fri 7/02.

All —

- I will provision an SFTP drop and a structured Drive folder by 2027-07-02. Evidence inventory template will be pre-populated with expected file names and tags.
- Revised MAP milestones (finalized optimistic timeline):
   * 2027-07-06 — Questionnaire complete (Owner: Olivia Barnes)
   * 2027-07-09 — First evidence batch uploaded (Owner: Olivia / KB evidence coordinator)
   * 2027-07-14 — Redwood security review complete (Owner: Monica)
   * 2027-07-21 — Remaining evidence uploaded (Owner: Olivia)
   * 2027-08-04 — Final package accepted / close (Target close)

Contingency timeline (if questionnaire slips to 7/08): target close moves to 2027-08-11.

Action items:
- Olivia: confirm evidence coordinator and whether SFTP is acceptable (EOD 6/30).
- Monica: attach the Sample Log Exports doc to the MAP (7/01).
- Ben: share the SFTP credentials and Drive structure once provisioned (7/02).

Olivia — tagging you here so you have the produced timeline. If this looks good I’ll upload the updated MAP workbook to the Drive link and mark owners.
